stem: An analyst computes the October ARPA of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription, as October's MRR divided by every business that has ever subscribed, including those that cancelled. What does this do?

options.text: ARPA is too low: cancelled businesses add to the count but pay nothing
ARPA comes out too high, because the cancelled businesses paid more before they left
ARPA is unchanged, because cancelled businesses have an MRR of 0
ARPA turns into lifetime value per business, since every business counts
